Hi friends!
You know by now that I’m always dreaming up ways to make life just a little sweeter , and this fall, I’m extra excited to share my latest idea with you.

Introducing The Caramel Apple Club , a subscription box filled with our famous, handmade gourmet caramel apples, shipped right to your door.

Why did I want to create this? Well, there’s just something magical about caramel apples. They aren’t just a treat , they’re an experience. The crisp Granny Smith apple, the chewy homemade caramel, the fun toppings… it’s nostalgia, comfort, and celebration all wrapped into one delicious bite.

And honestly, I wanted to give you a way to enjoy that magic not just in the fall , but all year long.

Here’s How It Works:

Every month (or every other month, or once a season , you choose!), we’ll send you a sweet surprise featuring one of our favorite creations.

Sweet & Simple - Get 1 gourmet caramel apple each month for $19.95 (shipping included)
Shareable Delight - Get 3 gourmet caramel apples each month for $39.95 (shipping included)

Our team picks the flavors, so you’ll get a mix of classics, seasonal favorites, and maybe even a few crazy new flavors we’re experimenting with. It’s a little like opening a present every time a box arrives!

Behind the Scenes: How We Pick the Apples

This might be my favorite part. Each month, our team gathers around to brainstorm which flavors to send out. We argue (lovingly!) over whether to go with a fan favorite, a seasonal special, or something totally over the top. When we finally make our picks, there’s always this buzz of excitement , we can already picture you opening the box, taking that first bite, and smiling.

The Perfect Gift (Even If It’s for Yourself)

Whether you want to treat yourself (because you deserve it!) or surprise a friend, co-worker, or client, this is one gift that will bring smiles month after month.

Join the Club

So, are you ready to make your mailbox a little sweeter? I can’t wait for you to try it and share which apple is your favorite each month.

Click here to join The Caramel Apple Club , The Sweetest Club You’ll Ever Join!

posts.title: My Favorite: Buckeyes!
posts.excerpt: Yummy Treat Alert: Peanut Butter Chocolate Buckeyes! Do you love peanut butter and chocolate? Then you're going to love buckeyes! What Are Buckeyes? Buckeyes are a sweet treat...
posts.bodyHtml:
Yummy Treat Alert: Peanut Butter Chocolate Buckeyes!

Do you love peanut butter and chocolate? Then you're going to love buckeyes!

What Are Buckeyes?
Buckeyes are a sweet treat made with peanut butter and chocolate. They look like the nut from the buckeye tree, which is round and brown with a light spot, just like this candy!

What’s Inside?
Buckeyes are made with creamy peanut butter, a little butter, and powdered sugar. That gets mixed together to make a soft, yummy dough. Then we roll the dough into small balls.

The Chocolate Dip
After the balls are made, we dip them in melted chocolate. But here’s the fun part, we don’t dip them all the way! We leave a little bit of peanut butter showing at the top. That’s what makes them look like real buckeyes!

So Delicious!
Buckeyes are sweet, soft, and a little bit crunchy from the chocolate. If you love peanut butter cups, you’ll definitely love buckeyes.

When Do People Eat Buckeyes?
People eat buckeyes all year long, but they’re super popular during holidays and football season, especially in Ohio, where the buckeye is the state tree!

Want to Try One?
You don’t have to wait until a holiday to enjoy this treat. You can buy them or even try making them at home with an adult. Just be careful with the melted chocolate, it's hot!

Final Bite
Peanut butter chocolate buckeyes are fun to eat, easy to love, and always delicious. They might just become your new favorite treat!

posts.title: The Sweet History of Caramel Apples
posts.excerpt: When fall rolls in, caramel apples make their grand (and delicious) return. But did you know this classic treat hasn’t been around all that long? Caramel apples first came onto...
posts.bodyHtml:
When fall rolls in, caramel apples make their grand (and delicious) return. But did you know this classic treat hasn’t been around all that long?

Caramel apples first came onto the scene in the 1950s, when Dan Walker, a Kraft Foods employee, melted leftover caramels and dipped in apples as a fun experiment. The combo of tart, juicy apples and sweet, buttery caramel was an instant hit, and the recipe was soon printed on Kraft caramel packages across the country.

While candied apples date back to the early 1900s, caramel apples offered a softer, chewier bite. It didn’t take long for them to become a fall favorite at fairs, festivals, and Halloween parties.

Over time, the humble caramel apple evolved, topped with everything from crushed nuts and chocolate drizzle to sprinkles and gourmet goodies. Today, they’re not just a nostalgic treat; they’re a work of edible art.

posts.bodyHtml:
That's right! We sell Chocolate Dipped Bottles of Wine! These decadent gifts are perfect for the person who has everything! I love wine, and obviously...chocolate! You can easily gift a bottle of wine and a box of our chocolate, but why not take it up a notch!?

Of course, my friend Jenn brought this idea to me! Her and I have had the best brainstorming sessions over the years (only some of them included wine!). I couldn't resist jumping on this idea and figure out the best way for us to make the idea come to life!

So, how does it work?

Bring us your favorite bottle of wine, pick out your bottle design, then return to pick up your bottle in a just 5 days!

First, we add a ribbon to the bottle of your wine bottle and then cover the bottle in cellophane. Then, we dip and decorate the bottle with chocolate, sprinkles, drizzle, etc. Once it is dipped and decorated, we cellophane the outside and add a festive bow!

Do you gnaw the chocolate off the bottle? No....remember the pull ribbon? That's the magic chocolate release! Once the recipient is ready to dive in, just pull the string and the chocolate will break off for you to enjoy!

Watch our video - here!

Bottle dipping is $29.98

posts.title: Mother's Day
posts.excerpt: Where do I start? As a new(ish) Mom, I have a whole new view of Mother's Day. I am lucky to have two daughters (2 years and 6 months) and experiencing motherhood is the best, most...
posts.bodyHtml:
Where do I start? As a new(ish) Mom, I have a whole new view of Mother's Day. I am lucky to have two daughters (2 years and 6 months) and experiencing motherhood is the best, most rewarding, and sometimes most challenging, thing I have ever done!

I am blessed to have phenomenal role models in my life that help me navigate this time in my life everyday. This year, I had more time to dedicate to making a few new products for the shoppe to highlight moms, and I had a lot of fun coming up with new ideas!

We also decided to partner with a local mom that has a homebased floral business! During our initial meeting, we both said how nice it is to be able to relate to another mom in business. The ideas we have will be released in a few weeks - TBD!

Anyways, my mom. My Mom (pictured with me), is the strongest woman I have ever known. She has faced ups and downs in her life and has continued to be a source of unwavering support for our family. While she doesn't spend much time in the shoppe, she is one of the people that I go to first with ideas, and also problems! She is there for it all. My Favorite Sweet Shoppe wouldn't be where it is today with out her help and guidance.

Mother's Day is just a month away. I hope we all take a moment and think about a special way to honor our moms this year. Sometimes it is as simple as a homemade card from your kids and spending an afternoon together. I would love to hear about any of your Mother's Day traditions! Please share your Mother's Day stories in the comments!

posts.title: Gourmet Caramel Apples - The I Like Pie Apple
posts.excerpt: Gourmet Caramel Apples are one of our core products! I mean, there's one in our logo! It always surprises me how excited customers get when they see the window full of hand-dipped...
posts.bodyHtml:
Gourmet Caramel Apples are one of our core products! I mean, there's one in our logo! It always surprises me how excited customers get when they see the window full of hand-dipped caramel apples! Their smiles say it all - I want one!!!

Let's chat about our best-selling apple, the I Like Pie apple. Why is it the best-seller? Well, it tastes just like an apple pie! Let's start from the beginning...

We use Granny Smith apples for all of our caramel apples. The tart, sweet combo is just one we cannot resist! When we make a batch of homemade caramel, it takes about 3 hours and we can dip roughly 60-70 apples.

The I Like Pie Apple, gets dipped in homemade caramel, then, gets dipped in our creamy white chocolate blend and the bottom half gets rolled in our cinnamon sugar mixture and set to dry. We know...you don't like white chocolate, right? Give this guy a try and you won't be disappointed! It does get passed up by customers because of the white chocolate, which makes the apple really sad....

It may not be the prettiest apple we have, but trust us when we say it is THE BEST!

In fact, next time you stop in, buy one and if you don't LOVE it - it's on me!

Check out all of our Gourmet Caramel Apples here!
